verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a corporate law firm could plausibly publish guidance on entity and jurisdiction choice. The evidence only shows advisory support 'from incorporation through to exit' and UK/DE cap table templates. No published guidance compares Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd, or helps a founder pick an entity type and jurisdiction for their market. Incorporation advice as a service and cap-table tools are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
